LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 3.3.1 CORRELATIVE CONJUNCTIONS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.3: Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Which words do we use when making a choice between two things?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify correlative conjunctions in an oral or written text
2. use correlative conjunctions correctly in oral and written communication
3. use the pattern show... nominal... how/where/who in sentences

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify correlative conjunctions in an oral or written text
   In simple words: practise until you can identify correlative conjunctions in an oral or written text. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use correlative conjunctions correctly in oral and written communication
   In simple words: practise until you can use correlative conjunctions correctly in oral and written communication. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. use the pattern show... nominal... how/where/who in sentences
   In simple words: practise until you can use the pattern show... nominal... how/where/who in sentences. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions.
4. Show that you can: identify correlative conjunctions in an oral or written text

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Correlative Conjunctions important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Construct sentences using show... nominal... how/where/who,
2. Fill in blanks in provided sentences to practise the use of the pattern how/where/who,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify correlative conjunctions in an oral or written text
2. use correlative conjunctions correctly in oral and written communication
3. use the pattern show... nominal... how/where/who in sentences

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
